story_title: HiBob turns 2,500 GPTs into product and team growth
caption:
How many AI assistants does a company actually need? HR platform HiBob didn't settle for just one—they deployed 2,500 custom GPTs using ChatGPT Enterprise across their product and teams.

By tailoring AI tools to micro-workflows rather than forcing staff into a generic chatbot, HiBob boosted internal AI adoption and used those insights to drive new revenue features in the Bob platform.

Is granular micro-AI the true blueprint for enterprise SaaS?

alt_text_overall: GetByteRush carousel explaining how HiBob deployed 2,500 custom GPTs using ChatGPT Enterprise to scale team growth and product features.
alt_text_per_slide: Slide 1: ONE COMPANY. 2,500 CUSTOM GPTs.. Most organizations struggle to adopt a single AI bot. HR platform HiBob built thousands of them. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.

Slide 2: WHY BUILD 2,500 DIFFERENT AIs?. Instead of forcing employees into one generic assistant, HiBob integrated custom GPTs directly into distinct internal team workflows. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 3: SCALING THROUGH CHATGPT ENTERPRISE. By leveraging ChatGPT Enterprise, custom GPTs were created to streamline HR workflows, increase internal productivity, and boost overall adoption. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 4: FROM INTERNAL TOOL TO PRODUCT FEATURE. The strategy extended beyond internal productivity—insights from thousands of GPTs helped power AI capabilities directly inside the core Bob platform. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 5: THE DEATH OF THE GENERAL ASSISTANT.. 2,500 GPTs proves that hyper-specific, micro-task AI tools outperform generic master chatbots in real enterprise environments. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 6: WHAT THIS MEANS FOR TECH BUILDERS. Companies that win with AI won't just buy a license for everyone. They will empower teams to construct granular, automated tools tailored to exact jobs. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 7: SPECIALIZATION SCALES.. The future of AI in software isn't one universal bot. It's thousands of silent, specialized engines working in unison. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.
